research.title: Visual Inspection Baselines for Surface Defect Classification
bullets: Prepared labeled surface image datasets by checking annotation consistency, removing duplicate images, and separating training and evaluation sets by source specimen.
Implemented histogram of oriented gradients features with linear support vector classification, examining baseline errors across defect categories and lighting conditions.

publications.title: Surface Defect Classification with Gradient Features: Dataset Preparation and Baseline Error Analysis

work.title: Inventory and Order Documentation Support
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing lists, recorded discrepancies, and routed missing item reports to the appropriate staff for follow-up.
Organized order paperwork, updated stock records from approved forms, and prepared routine handover notes documenting unresolved delivery and inventory issues.

projects.title: Nearest Neighbor Baseline for Handwritten Digit Recognition
bullets: Implemented a nearest neighbor classifier using normalized grayscale pixel vectors, following a standard baseline workflow for handwritten digit image classification.
Compared distance metrics and neighborhood settings on a validation split, then inspected confusion patterns and misclassified examples from held-out images.
